ranking_methods.position_boards: Pre-ranked by Glory when matched, then production score, EPA impact, basic stats, profile fallback.
ranking_methods.breakout_radar: Production, usage, or EPA deltas versus prior player season; first-year impact when no prior season exists.
ranking_methods.transfer_impact: Transfer profile plus supported player score; profile-only transfers remain low confidence.
ranking_methods.hidden_gems: High supported impact outside top 15 overall visibility with lower usage or strong per-play EPA.
ranking_methods.physical_outliers: Within-position height, weight, and BMI percentiles from roster data.
ranking_methods.archetypes: Only archetypes supported by available basic stats/rates are emitted.

missing_or_pending: True starter flags are not available.
Deep target rate and blocking grades are not available.
Team position need score is not available.
Some roster positions are missing and map to Unknown.
confidence_notes: Player identities use canonical PERS IDs from the roster entity pipeline.
Stats and Glory are joined by normalized player name plus school-season; unmatched rows are omitted from ranking signals.
Labels are reason-coded and confidence-aware; profile-only widgets are low confidence.
